mainEntity.name: How can I manage my construction budget to avoid overruns?

acceptedAnswer.text: Managing a construction budget effectively requires regular monitoring and proactive decision-making. Establish a clear change order process to track and approve any deviations from the original plan. Maintain open communication with your contractor to stay informed about progress and potential cost impacts. A crucial step Hometelligent Inc. recommends is to review expenses against the budget frequently and make timely adjustments, especially when unexpected conditions arise, to mitigate significant overruns.
